import pathlib,sysconfig,hashlib; p=pathlib.Path(sysconfig.get_path('purelib'))/'a1_coverage.pth'; assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'ef2ed06d19867ec669c09a804060666a9cd5e383af0a9d11aa2de79b77d448e8'; p.unlink(); print('Removed unused conditional coverage startup hook; coverage run instrumentation remains explicit')
import tempfile,subprocess,importlib.metadata,json
before_dist=importlib.metadata.distribution('pydantic')
installed_root=pathlib.Path(before_dist.locate_file('pydantic'))
def package_hashes():
    return {str(p.relative_to(installed_root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in installed_root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts}
before=package_hashes()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='rio-pydantic-wheel-') as wheel_tmp:
    subprocess.run(['uv','build','--offline','--wheel','--python',sys.executable,'--out-dir',wheel_tmp],check=True)
    wheels=list(pathlib.Path(wheel_tmp).glob('pydantic-*.whl'))
    assert len(wheels)==1,wheels
    wheel=wheels[0]
    print('Self-package wheel SHA256',hashlib.sha256(wheel.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
    subprocess.run(['uv','pip','install','--offline','--no-deps','--reinstall','--python',sys.executable,str(wheel)],check=True)
    assert package_hashes()==before,'Wheel reinstall changed own-package contents'
    dist=importlib.metadata.distribution('pydantic')
    direct=json.loads(dist.read_text('direct_url.json'))
    assert direct['url'].endswith('.whl') and not direct.get('dir_info',{}).get('editable')
    print('Own package code byte-identical after wheel-file reinstall; metadata:',json.dumps(direct),flush=True)
